description: School holiday dates in the UK for a calendar year (half terms, Easter, summer, Christmas, and training days). With council, that council's published term dates, each school year with the council's source link and the date Leave Hacker last checked it; for a school year it hasn't published, and without a council, TYPICAL dates, which are the usual pattern and not official (Northern Ireland: the Department of Education's dates). Every holiday says which it is. Academies and independent schools can set their own, so tell the person to check their school's.

council.description: The UK council whose term dates the school follows: its name ("Surrey", "Edinburgh"), its id ("surrey", "city-of-edinburgh") or the first half of a postcode ("GU1", "EH1"), looked up in Leave Hacker's own copy of the ONS list. Send only the first half of a postcode, not the full one.

region.description: UK nation: england-and-wales, scotland or northern-ireland. Defaults to england-and-wales, or to the council's nation when council is given.

year.description: Calendar year, e.g. 2027. Defaults to this year.

name: get_school_holidays

council.description: The council whose published dates are used, or null for typical dates

schoolYears.description: Where each school year's dates come from

checked.description: yyyy-MM-dd the dates were last checked against it

source.description: council: the council's published term dates; typical: the usual pattern, not official

sourceUrl.description: The council's own page or PDF

trainingDays.description: The council's staff training (INSET) days: pupils are off, staff work

typical.description: True when every date here is typical, not published

title: School holidays
